name: firmngin-data-agent-worker
description: Firmngin data-agent runtime for Cloudflare Workers (user-owned, BYOK)

WORKER_TOKEN.description: The `fng_aow_...` workspace token shown once on the Firmngin deploy card (AI Agents → Always-On Agent → Deploy Worker). It authorizes this Worker to your Firmngin workspace.

MODEL_API_KEY.description: Your model provider key (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, ...). **It stays in Cloudflare** — Firmngin never sees it.

WAKE_SECRET.description: Independent random secret of at least 32 bytes used only to authenticate Firmngin realtime wake requests. Do not reuse your Worker token or model key.

WORKER_BASE_URL.description: This Worker's public HTTPS origin only, e.g. `https://worker.example.com` (no path, query, hash or credentials). Provisioned once; the runtime derives and reports the exact `/v1/wake` URL. Preferred for new deployments.

WAKE_CALLBACK_URL.description: Legacy: full public HTTPS URL ending exactly in `/v1/wake`. Used only when `WORKER_BASE_URL` is absent; leave empty for new deployments.

URL_BACKEND.description: Firmngin API base URL. Leave the committed default unless the deploy card tells you otherwise.
